text: Binary flag (1/0) from the OP's "argument" text only (current text, including marked edits): 1 if the OP, in their own voice, explicitly compares their claim, case or proposal to an established scientific norm (accepted standard, consensus, established finding/practice) or established historical norm (long-standing standard, practice, precedent), stating similarity or difference. 0 if there is no such explicit comparison; merely mentioning science or history without comparing to a norm doesn't count. Excludes quotations or positions attributed to others unless the OP adopts them. Excludes view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred, even if otherwise qualifying; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and not itself a norm comparison. Null if argument is missing or malformed.
